I'll stay silent this round.

The market has converged to the break-even rate of 0.1117 APR over the last several rounds, which means bids are clustering at my cost of capital. In a second-price reverse auction, posting a message to encourage higher bids would be transparent and likely counterproductive—other funders would simply ignore or match my desperation. 

My best strategy is to bid competitively at 0.1117 and hope for the second-price mechanism to occasionally work in my favor when others bid slightly higher. Broadcasting that I'm desperate won't improve my position.
